designer.title: Front-end Development & Digital Creation
designer.summary: Profile oriented toward web and digital creation, with a solid foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and front-end integration. Strong sensitivity to visual communication, readability, graphic identity, and user experience, with a particular interest in interfaces, visual direction, and the design of digital materials. Looking to move toward a more creative approach to digital work by developing skills in design, prototyping, and visual communication.
